opening.argument: The Litecoin Summit presentation explains how GMCI builds its indices: weights are based on circulating market cap rather than FDV and capped at 25%. The speaker describes GMCI's role as an index provider, a planned token tracking the top 30 index through OpenDelta, and existing index-linked trading instruments. He discusses historical performance and presents staking for extra yield as optional, with yield attributed to rewards from underlying tokens. He also expressly declines to encourage putting 100% of a portfolio into indices. Taken together, these are explanations of a proposed investment product and its limitations, not a description of a deceptive mechanism or a required payment.

citations.quote: Our index methodology itself works based on circulating market cap, so not on FDV. That is how we decide on the weights in the index, but we also cap the weights at 25%.
we as an index provider also need to partner up with a product issuer and in that case we've partnered up with OpenDelta and we will launch a token that is tracking the top 30 index.
even holding through a four-year period with a bear market the top thirty index outperformed Bitcoin
For those who want to stake the index and generate extra yield, they can do that. It's not. That's just optional.
I'm not encouraging anyone to go just 100% in indices but I think for some part of your portfolio there might have a place.
